record.name: Hifz AI: Tarteel Quran ترتيل
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Master Quran memorization (Hifz) with AI-powered mistake correction and real-time feedback.

Tarteel - Hifz AI is your personal Quran companion, designed to bridge the gap between listening and active recitation. Whether you are revising a specific Surah or memorizing for the first time, our advanced AI listens to your recitation and provides real-time feedback, helping you correct mistakes instantly.

Perfect for beginners, students, and families - our clean, distraction-free Mushaf interface makes Quran learning accessible and easy for kids and adults.


AI-POWERED TARTEEL CORRECTION

Act as your own teacher with our advanced AI recitation analysis.

- Real-Time Feedback: The app listens to your Arabic recitation and highlights mistakes in Red and correct words in Green
- Self-Listening (New): Instantly hear your own recorded voice after reciting to objectively compare your Tajweed against the expert Qari.
- Privacy First: All AI processing happens offline on your device. Your voice data is never sent to the cloud
- Silence Detection: Automatically stops recording when you finish an Ayah
- Repeat Until Correct: Repeat an Ayah until your recitation is correct.


ADVANCED AUDIO PLAYBACK

Customize your listening experience to suit your learning speed.

- Adaptive Delay: Automatically adjusts the pause between Ayahs based on their length
- Custom Range Practice: Select specific verses (e.g., Ayah 10-15) to create focused loops
- Loop & Repeat: Set custom ranges, repeat single Ayahs, or loop entire Surahs
- Speed Control: Adjust playback speed from 0.5x to 2.0x
- Background Play: Continue your Quran listening even when the screen is off


COMPLETE QURAN LIBRARY

- Full Access: All 114 Surahs with high-quality audio from expert Qaris
- Offline Support: Download Surahs on-demand and practice anywhere without internet
- Visual Comfort: Choose from 7 beautiful font scripts (Uthmanic, IndoPak, Naskh) and adjust text size
- Smart Navigation: Search by Surah name or number and jump instantly to any Ayah


PRIVACY & CONVENIENCE

- Secure Account: Log in securely to sync your purchases across devices. Your learning progress is safely saved locally on your device.
- On-Device Processing: Your voice recordings stay on your device - never uploaded
- Storage Management: Easily manage downloads to save space


Perfect for families: Simple enough for children to use, yet powerful enough for serious Hafiz students. Used by Muslims around the world perfecting their Quran (قرآن) recitation and Tarteel (ترتيل) today.

---

record.name: SmartScroll: Lumi AI Tutor
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Homework Help Should Go Further

Getting an answer can solve tonight’s problem. Learning what comes next is different.

SmartScroll is a parent-managed learning and AI tutoring app for students in grades 6–12. It brings homework help, short lessons, guided practice, structured AI tutoring, review, and visible progress together in one place.

MEET LUMI, YOUR AI TUTOR

Students can ask Lumi for help by typing a question or taking a photo. Lumi supports Math, Science, English, History, Spanish, and Financial Literacy with hints, guiding questions, worked examples, and step-by-step explanations designed to teach the method—not simply provide an answer.

SmartScroll also includes scheduled, AI-guided tutoring sessions based on the learner’s subject, grade, progress, recent activity, and identified gaps. Lumi is an automated AI tutor, not a live human tutoring appointment, and AI can sometimes be wrong. Important answers should be checked with a teacher or textbook.

LEARN LIKE YOU SCROLL

SmartScroll turns a familiar vertical feed into short learning interactions. Students move through lessons and practice while the feed responds to what they have worked on and where they may need more support.

A structured learning Path shows what comes next, organizes skills into courses and units, and gives students a clear place to continue instead of leaving them with disconnected answers.

HOMEWORK PHOTO HELP

Take a photo. Type a question. Ask Lumi. Then continue into practice, review, or the learning Path.

When photo help is available, images are processed to answer the request. SmartScroll does not save uploaded homework images in its application database or object storage. AI-provider handling is described in our Privacy Policy. SmartScroll is designed to make homework help the beginning of learning—not the end of it.

PRACTICE. REVIEW. REMEMBER.

SmartScroll uses guided examples, independent practice, review, and remediation to help students revisit skills and build progress over time. Goals, streaks, levels, mastery indicators, and progress feedback make consistent studying easier to understand.

BUILT FOR STUDENTS. VISIBLE TO PARENTS.

Students get a dedicated learning experience. Parents can link learner devices, review progress demonstrated in SmartScroll, and see tutoring reports across linked devices. Families with Full Program access can support up to three learners.

HEALTHY AND PRIVATE BY DESIGN

SmartScroll optimizes what students learn, not how long they stay. There is no infinite autoplay, no public social feed, no advertising, and no sale of personal data. Daily goals and natural stopping points help learning end at a healthy time.

Students do not create accounts with an email or password. Parent accounts manage access and linked learners. SmartScroll collects only the information needed to operate the learning experience, and parents can review or delete their family’s data.

SUBSCRIPTIONS

SmartScroll offers auto-renewable monthly and yearly subscriptions through Apple In-App Purchase. Eligible new subscribers may receive an introductory trial. The exact localized price, billing period, trial eligibility, and renewal terms appear before purchase. Payment is charged to the Apple ID at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period and can be managed or canceled in Apple ID subscription settings.

Privacy Policy: https://smartscroll.org/privacy
Terms of Use: https://smartscroll.org/terms

Ask. Practice. Review. Progress.
SmartScroll. Learn like you scroll.

Sarthi AI is your personal study companion: one place to plan what to study, practice it, and get unstuck the moment a doubt appears. No waiting for a teacher. No searching through twenty videos. Just you, your syllabus, and someone beside you who never gets tired of your questions.

Studying through your school or college? Institutions can license Sarthi for their students directly; provisioned students sign in with the credentials their institution issues and get their institution's plan without an in-app purchase. Everyone else can subscribe or buy coins in the app.

ASK ANYTHING, ANY TIME
A concept that won't click. A numerical that won't balance. A textbook question nobody explained properly. Type it in plain words, or just snap a photo. Sarthi walks you through it step by step, with proper maths notation, a diagram when a diagram helps, and a chart when numbers need a picture. Clarity, not walls of text.

A STUDY PLAN THAT FITS YOUR LIFE
Tell Sarthi your board, your syllabus and how much time you really have. It builds a day-by-day plan you can actually keep up with, and quietly reshapes it as you progress instead of guilt-tripping you when life happens.

PRACTICE TESTS, GRADED IN MOMENTS
Build a test from your syllabus or from your own uploaded material. MCQs, written answers, rapid-fire rounds. Submit and see exactly where the marks went, and why, so the next attempt is better than the last.

LEARN FROM YOUR OWN NOTES
Upload your notes or textbook PDFs and Sarthi turns them into study material, tests and explanations built from what YOU are actually studying. Your chapters, your teacher's emphasis, your words.

LISTEN AND LEARN
Turn any topic into audio: clear explanations, quick recaps, even story-style lessons. Revise on the bus, in the queue, or with the lights off.

SHOW UP, GET STRONGER
Daily streaks, XP and achievements that reward the work you actually do. Levels here are earned, never handed out.

STUDY IN YOUR LANGUAGE
The full experience in English and Hindi: the interface, Sarthi's explanations, and audio too. Your language is not a setting to work around. It is where you think best.

BUILT FOR HOW INDIAN STUDENTS STUDY
Made for school and junior-college students across CBSE, ICSE, State Boards and more, from Class 5 to Class 12. Not a classroom broadcast. One student, one companion.

＼Santaアルクは、こんな方におすすめの英語学習アプリです！／
・短期間で効率よくTOEICスコアや英語スキルを上げたい
・就職や転職、昇格のために一刻も早く結果を出したい
・通勤中や移動中のスキマ時間に、スマホひとつで手軽に英語学習を進めたい
・自分の弱点をAIに分析してもらい、無駄のない英語学習をしたい
・TOEICリスニングのスコアが伸び悩んでおり、パート別に対策したい
・頻出のTOEIC単語や英文法を、スキマ時間で集中的に暗記したい
・時間や場所を気にせず、独学で英語のスキルアップを目指したい
・これまで英語の勉強に挫折してきたが、今度こそ習慣化させたい
・AIによる高精度なスコア診断で、現在の英語レベルを手軽に確認したい

【Santaアルクの主な機能】
■ 精度95%、3分でできるAIスコア診断
TOEICは2時間の試験を受けて英語力をスコア化しますが、SantaアルクならAIが3分でスコアを診断します。実際のスコアから平均誤差20点以内というデータがあり、正確に実力を把握できます。

■ パーソナライズされた最短ルートの英語学習
AIがユーザーの弱点を分析し、スコアアップに必要なTOEIC単語やパート別演習、動画講義をレコメンド。忙しい社会人でも無駄なく最短で目標達成へ導きます。

■ スコアをリアルタイム予測！本番に向けたパート別演習
4.5億以上の学習データを解析した独自のAI*が、あなたの英語スキルを分析。実際のテスト26回分に相当する5,200問を収録。質の高い演習ができ、学習するたびに予測スコアが更新されるためモチベーションが維持できます。
*SantaアルクのAI技術は、AI領域で世界トップ2の学会であるNIPS （世界神経情報処理システム学会）に認定されています。

■ 新登場！学習継続を支える、AI成果伴走サービス
ユーザーに合わせた日々のメッセージだけでなく、学習ログから離脱の兆しをAIが検知。ベストなタイミングでのリマインドで、忙しい毎日の英語学習の習慣化をサポートします
 
■ アルクの人気書籍もアプリで学習可能に
「あがる1000問」や「キクタンBasic」など、人気の対策書籍に搭載されている問題もアプリ内で学習可能です。

■ 初めて受ける方でも安心の初級コース
基礎的なTOEIC単語や文法をAIが厳選。カリキュラム型でしっかり学べる入門コースです。

■ パート別解法テクニック動画コンテンツ
頻出英文法やTOEICリスニング・リーディングなど、解法のコツを解説した動画を約200本収録。いつでも視聴することができます。

■ レベル別で対策できるTOEIC単語＆模擬試験機能
「基礎英単語500語」「必須リスニング」などレベル別のメニューを収録。模擬試験機能では、テスト本番同様の形式で「200問（Full）」「100問（Half）」「30問（Mini）」から選択できます。

■ 弱点をまとめて撲滅！復習機能
間違えた問題は正解するまで繰り返し復習が可能。ブックマーク機能を使えば、覚えていないTOEIC単語だけを集中的に学習することもできます。 

■ Santa Lumi（AI質問機能）
解けなかった問題や文法の疑問を、いつでもAIに質問して即解決。独学でも迷わず勉強が進められます。 

【Santaアルクの特長】  
■ あなただけの学習計画が立てられる、パーソナライズ学習 
AIがユーザーの弱点や今後伸ばせるスキルを詳細に分析し、スコアアップに必要な学習カリキュラムを自動でレコメンドしてくれます。  

■ 学習モチベーション維持につながる、リアルタイムスコア診断 
学習を進めるたびに予測スコアが更新されます。スコアアップが実感でき、モチベーションアップにつながります。  

■「続け方」までサポートするから、スコアアップがより効率的に
従来のスコア診断やレコメンド機能に加え、最適なタイミングでのリマインドで学習を促進。学習が続かないお悩みを解消し、目標スコア達成に近づくことができます。  

■ 今後も最新の学習機能・コンテンツを随時追加予定
AI研究・アプリデベロッパーとして、TOEIC学習者の学習体験の向上を追求しており、さまざまな新しい機能を追加しています。 

【よくある質問（FAQ）】 
＜Santaアルクの特徴・機能について＞ 
Q：Santaアルクとは、どのようなアプリですか？
A：最先端のAIが一人ひとりの英語力を分析し、内容を最適化してくれるTOEIC対策に特化した英語学習アプリです。 

Q：他のアプリと比較した際の一番の特長・強みは何ですか？
A：高精度なAIが現在のTOEIC予測スコアや苦手な弱点分野を瞬時に分析し、「最短でスコアアップするために今一番必要な問題」を自動で提案してくれる点（タイパの良さ）です。 

Q：アプリ内では、どのような対策ができますか？
A：スコアアップに必要なTOEICリスニング、リーディング、TOEIC単語、英文法まで、すべての試験対策をこのアプリひとつで網羅して学ぶことができます。 

Q：現在の自分のスコアを予測することはできますか？ 
A：はい、可能です。「AIスコア診断」を受けていただくと、たった3分でAIが高精度に予測し、現在の英語の実力を数値化して把握することができます。 

Q：アプリ内で、模試や本番形式の模擬試験を受けることはできますか？ 
A：はい、本番さながらの演習が可能です。マークシート形式で解答できる30問（ミニ）・100問（ハーフ）・200問（本番フル形式）の実践模擬試験機能が搭載されており、直前の総仕上げにご利用いただけます。 

＜学習の進め方・対象レベルについて＞ 
Q：どのレベルのスコアの人に向いているサービスですか？ 
A：初受験者から、800点以上を目指す上級者まで、すべてのレベルの方にご利用いただけます。AIスコア診断によって、現在の実力に応じた最適な学習プランが自動生成されます。「英語に自信がない初心者」や「ブランクが長い社会人」の方でも、自分に合った難易度で安心して英語学習を始められます。 

Q：対策を始める場合、まずは何からスタートすればいいですか？ 
A：アプリをダウンロードしたら、まずは「AIスコア診断」で実力を把握してください。その後は、AIが弱点を分析して自動で組む「おすすめ学習」に沿って、TOEICリスニングやTOEIC単語などの問題を解き進めるのが最短ルートです。 

Q：AIスコア診断は、何回でも繰り返し受けられますか？ 
A：はい、制限なく何回でも受けることができます。問題を解くごとにデータがリアルタイムで分析され、予測スコアが常に最新の状態へと更新されます。 

＜サポート・アカウント・その他について＞ 
Q：独学だと継続できるか不安です。サポート機能はありますか？
A：はい、継続のための伴走サポートが充実しています。AIが毎日の状況を分析し、適切なタイミングでのリマインド通知やメッセージを送信することで、挫折しやすい毎日の英語学習の習慣化をしっかりサポートします。 

Q：開催されるオンラインセミナーとは、どのような講義内容ですか？
A：有名著者や人気講師を特別ゲストに招き、効率的な英語学習法やパート別の攻略法などを徹底解説するオンライン講義です。こちらは有料プランにご登録いただいている方限定でご参加いただけます。 

Q：スマートフォンの機種変更をしてもデータは引き継げますか？
A：はい、可能です。事前に登録したアカウント情報を使って新しい端末からログインしていただくことで、これまでの学習履歴、予測スコア、購入プラン情報がすべて正常に引き継がれます。

Most Arabic apps teach you how to order coffee. Takallam teaches you the Arabic you actually pray in.

Takallam is built for English-speaking Muslims who can read the letters but not the meaning — who want to understand the Quran, follow a khutbah, and hold a real conversation in Fus'ha (Modern Standard Arabic).

SPEAK FROM THE FIRST LESSON
Talk to an AI tutor that replies in Arabic at your level. It waits when you need time, and it never gets bored of repeating itself.

PRONUNCIATION THAT GETS CORRECTED
Say the word out loud and get scored on it. See which sound was off, hear it done properly, and try again — the kind of feedback you would normally need a teacher for.

A REAL CURRICULUM, NOT A GAME
Lessons designed by expert teachers and sequenced so each one builds on the last. You always know what you are learning and why.

QURANIC ARABIC, MADE CLEAR
Learn the vocabulary and structures that actually appear in the Quran, so the words you already recite start to carry meaning.

GRAMMAR WITHOUT THE TEXTBOOK
When you make a mistake, you get a short explanation on the spot — in plain English, in context, then straight back to the lesson.

REVIEW THAT ADAPTS TO YOU
Takallam tracks what you are forgetting and brings it back before it is gone. Five minutes a day is enough to hold ground.

WHO IT IS FOR
- Complete beginners who know the alphabet but not the language
- Muslims who pray in Arabic and want to understand what they are saying
- Anyone who tried Duolingo Arabic and stalled after the alphabet
- Students of Quranic Arabic who want speaking practice, not just flashcards

Takallam is free to download and includes a free trial. Continued access to full lessons, personalised AI review, and AI conversation practice requires a paid subscription.

E quase ninguém tem um lugar para errar em voz alta sem pagar mico.

A Amiora é esse lugar, antes de valer nota.

Vídeos de verdade em inglês: entrevistas na rua, conversas do dia a dia, podcasts, cenas de filme, trailers. Gente falando como fala entre si, não ator lendo roteiro para estudante.

Cada vídeo é escolhido para o seu nível, não para o nível que uma apostila acha que você deveria ter.

Dein Englisch ist gut. Gut genug, dass dich seit Jahren niemand mehr korrigiert hat.

Dann sitzt du im Call, jemand fragt dich etwas direkt, und du hörst dich antworten: korrekt, freundlich, und viel einfacher als das, was du sagen wolltest.

Auf Deutsch wärst du hier präzise gewesen. Vielleicht sogar witzig.

Das ist keine Wissenslücke.

Ab einem bestimmten Niveau geht es nicht mehr darum, ob man dich versteht, sondern wie du dabei wirkst — und das trainiert man nur, indem man spricht.

Die meisten haben dafür keinen Ort.

Amiora ist der Ort, an dem du übst, bevor es zählt.

SCHAUEN

Echte Clips auf Englisch: Straßeninterviews, Vlogs, Podcasts, Filmszenen, Trailer. Menschen, die reden, wie sie wirklich reden, keine Schauspieler mit Lerntext.

Jeder Clip passt zu deinem Niveau, nicht zu dem, auf dem du laut Lehrplan sein solltest.

Verstehst du alles, bleibt nichts hängen. Verstehst du nichts, schaltest du ab. Dazwischen wächst eine Sprache.

Tipp ein Wort an und sieh, was es in diesem Satz bedeutet, gesagt von dieser Person, in diesem Moment. Nicht im Wörterbuch.

SPRECHEN

Sprich über das, was du gerade gesehen hast. Statusmeeting, Kundencall, Vorstellungsgespräch, Small Talk vor dem Termin.

Die Stimme drängelt nicht und seufzt nicht. Du darfst dich hundertmal verhaspeln, und niemand erfährt davon.

Willst du eine Korrektur, kommt sie freundlich.

Das ist der Teil, den alle überspringen, und genau der Teil, der wirkt.

Ein Satz, den du laut gesagt hast, sitzt fester als einer, den du noch einmal gelesen hast.

Ein guter Lehrer bleibt das Beste, was es gibt. Ein KI-Tutor ist das Nächstbeste: um elf Uhr abends wach und nie genervt von derselben Frage.

WÖRTER

Jedes Wort, das du zum Üben hinzufügst, taucht in deinen Karteikarten wieder auf, zum richtigen Zeitpunkt für dich. Keine lange Liste zum Pauken.

Der Zeitpunkt ist die eigentliche Wissenschaft.

Erinnerung fällt entlang einer Kurve ab, und ein Wort, das kurz vor dem Verschwinden zurückkommt, ist zehn Wiederholungen eines Wortes wert, das du längst kannst.

Die Liste bleibt kurz, der Wortschatz wächst.

FORTSCHRITT

Keine Punkte, kein beleidigtes Maskottchen.

Wie viele Wörter du beim Sprechen benutzt hast, wie lange du geredet hast, ohne ins Deutsche zu wechseln, welche Fehler du nicht mehr machst.

WARUM DAS HIER ZÄHLT

- Im Job. Du kennst dein Thema besser als alle im Call. Die Frage ist, ob der Kunde das nach zehn Minuten auch so sieht.

- In der Nuance. „Das wird schwierig“ und „that's a bit tricky“ sind nicht dasselbe. Der Unterschied entscheidet, ob dein Nein als Position ankommt oder als Rückzieher.

- Wenn es schiefgeht. Jemand unterbricht dich, jemand versteht dich falsch. Wieder reinzukommen übt kaum jemand.

Auf Englisch so kompetent klingen, wie du auf Deutsch bist.

WAS DU HIER NICHT FINDEST

Es gibt eine tägliche Serie, weil Rhythmus hilft. Ein schlechtes Gewissen nicht.

Keine Herzen, keine Comicfiguren, keine Panikbildschirme. Du bist erwachsen, und so behandeln wir dich auch.

ABO

Das Schauen ist größtenteils kostenlos. Clips, interaktive Untertitel und Übersetzungen im Kontext sind für alle da, jeden Tag. Amiora Premium schaltet die Gespräche mit der KI frei.

Nobody ever fell in love with Spanish through a vocabulary list.

It was a scene you watched twice, the second time without subtitles. It was the conversation you followed to the end before realising you'd stopped translating.

Amiora is built for that, and for the fifteen minutes in the evening when it's possible.

WATCH

A feed of real video in Spanish: street interviews, everyday conversation, podcasts, clips and trailers.

Native speakers talking the way they talk to each other, not actors reading a script for learners.

English, French, Italian and Portuguese are here too, same feed, same tools.

Every clip is matched to where you are, not to where a course thinks you should be.

You acquire a language by understanding a little more than you comfortably can, so we look for the clip you'll follow most of, and reach for the rest.

Understand all of it and nothing sticks. Understand none of it and you switch off. That narrow band in between is where a language is actually learned.

Tap any word to see what it means in that sentence, in that moment, said by that person. Not in a dictionary.

SPEAK

Talk about what you just watched.

Order the coffee, argue about the ending, say the thing you'd never risk saying to a stranger in a language you're still finding.

The voice never rushes you and never sighs. You can be wrong a hundred times and nobody will know. Mistakes get corrected gently, and you control how thorough it is.

This is the part everyone skips, and it's the part that works.

Saying a word out loud fixes it far harder than reading it again, and it's the honest reason most of us are here: we don't want to know a language, we want to speak it.

A good human teacher is still the best thing there is.

An AI tutor is the next best thing, at a fraction of the cost, awake at eleven at night, and never tired of the same conversation.

WORDS

Every word you add to review comes back, timed for the evening you were about to forget it.

The timing is the science.

Memory fades along a curve, and a word brought back just before it goes is worth a dozen reviews of a word you already know.

So we return each word close to the last useful moment, then push the next review further out. The list stays short while the vocabulary grows.

PROGRESS

Not points. Not a mascot with a grievance.

The words you've actually said out loud, the minutes you held a conversation, the things you couldn't do in March and can do now.

WHY IT WORKS

Three ideas, none of them ours, all older than this app: comprehensible input (Krashen, 1981), active recall (Roediger and Karpicke, 2006), spaced repetition (Ebbinghaus, 1885).

And the connecting, which most apps leave out: the word you met on Tuesday is the word you said on Wednesday and still have on Saturday.

WHAT YOU WON'T FIND

There's a daily streak, because a bit of rhythm helps. There's no guilt attached to it.

No hearts to lose, no cartoons, no panic screens.

You're an adult who enjoys learning, and we'll treat you like one.
